gen-zen-dots-fs-nunito: Techy but friendly, Zen Dots gives every letter generous breathing room up top. Nunito takes over below with round, soft-cornered lowercase that keeps a full page of text feeling welcoming.
gen-zen-dots-gf-almarai: Zen Dots has a futuristic, open-handed look, with generous room around each letter. Almarai follows in a plain sans drawn like pencil lines, so a modest heading size lets the body text carry the page.
gen-zen-dots-gf-amarna: Zen Dots looks like bent copper pipe, spacious and a bit playful. Amarna keeps its strokes uniform and its small counters open, so paragraphs under that heading stay smooth and easy on the eye.
gen-zen-dots-gf-andika: Zen Dots reads like bent wire sign lettering, spacious and friendly, with a techy edge to every shape. Shrink it too far and Andika's sturdy, wide-turned body wins out.
gen-zen-dots-gf-assistant: Futuristic yet approachable, with generous room inside every letter. Zen Dots and Assistant together are strongest in how a spacious display heading hands off to a plain sans whose c, e and a stay open.
gen-zen-dots-gf-asta-sans: Zen Dots has a tubelike, spaced-out look, drawn friendly with a techy edge and no hairlines anywhere. Asta Sans echoes that constant line, only quieter and more settled.
gen-zen-dots-gf-bpmf-huninn: Looped, techy, and surprisingly friendly. The strongest quality of Zen Dots with Bpmf Huninn is how both feel like thin tubing bent into shape, one loud and spacious, the other quiet and modern.
gen-zen-dots-gf-bpmf-zihi-kai-std: Wide-open, techy letterforms give Zen Dots its character. Bpmf Zihi Kai Std adds a faint swell in its curves, so extended reading feels softer and more handwritten than the heading promises.
gen-zen-dots-gf-cairo: Zen Dots stands out for the generous space it leaves around every techy, friendly shape. Cairo settles in beneath it with wide channels into each bowl, so extended text keeps moving without effort.
gen-zen-dots-gf-cambay: Spacious, techy, and a touch playful, Zen Dots leads the way. And Cambay carries the reading, its rounds gapping like a cracked bangle, so paragraphs feel modern and light.
